card.name: Just before an ingredient is named
card.fires_on: Words right before a named ingredient or content amount, such as 'the active' before 'ingredient', or 'contain' and 'that' before a substance. Also the gap before an amount of a component.

modes.label: Active ingredient phrasing
modes.description: The word the or active just before the word ingredient in a description of what a drug contains.
modes.example: nausea, vomiting, or abdominal pain can occur during treatment with synthetic delta-9 tetrahydrocannabinol (delta-9-THC),<< the>> active ingredient in dronabinol oral

modes.label: Contains a substance
modes.description: Words like contain or that leading into a listed substance or its amount, such as phenylalanine or alcohol.
modes.example: Each 200 mg chewable tablet contains<< >>1.82 mg phenylalan

card.writes: It pushes the model to continue with words meaning ingredient, component or content, in English and Chinese.
card.plain: It fires when the text is about to say what a product contains, such as its active ingredient or how much of a substance is in it.
